actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the couatl’s next turn.
actions.name: Bite

agent_clauses: The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Medium or smaller creature the couatl can see within 5 feet. Failure: 8 (1d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.
actions.name: Constrict

actions.desc: The couatl casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
actions.name: Spellcasting

bonus_actions.desc: The couatl casts Bless, Lesser Restoration, or Sanctuary, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
bonus_actions.name: Divine Aid

traits.desc: The couatl’s thoughts can’t be read by any means, and other creatures can communicate with it telepathically only if it allows them.
traits.name: Shielded Mind
